elements_selected.content: `src/cap/age_encrypt.rs` effectful shell: accepts plaintext + cohort recipients + padding-tier, produces age v1 ciphertext via the `age` Rust crate. Recipients = union of real + padded pubkeys. Uses standard X25519 recipient type — no custom stanza. Testable via round-trip: Rust-encrypt → reference-age-cli decrypt with a real recipient key succeeds; decrypt with a padding-slot key fails.
